Lesson 9 of 10 in *Vital, step by step*: everything you need to feel at home in the real Vital plug-in. Short sections, one idea each. Click a heading to fold or open it.

::: {.ik-do}
**What you'll do**

1. Learn what polyphony, mono, glide and unison mean.
2. Hear a pad with 8 voices and with 1.
3. Make a mono bass glide.
4. Learn where the real Vital keeps these settings.
5. Check yourself.
:::

## Voices

- A **voice** is one note the synth can play. **Polyphony** is how many at once. Pads and chords need many; a bass line or a solo needs one.
- With **polyphony 1** the synth is *mono*: a new note cuts off the old one. That is often what you want for a bass.
- This page plays up to 16 voices. The real Vital's VOICES runs from 1 to 32 and starts at 8 (Vital source, voice_section.cpp; synth_parameters.cpp).

## Glide

- **Glide** (also called *portamento*) slides the pitch from one note to the next instead of jumping.
- On this page and in Vital the knob runs from -10 to 4; -10 is off (Vital source, synth_parameters.cpp). This page reads it as 2 to the power of the number in seconds: -5 = 0.03 s, -2 = 0.25 s (unverified).

## Unison

- **Unison** (lesson 2) stacks copies of each note. On this page, unison above 1 also makes the panel mono (its engine); the real Vital's unison is per oscillator and still plays chords (unverified).

Play it from the keys under it, the computer keys (a w s e d f t g y h u j k) or a MIDI keyboard (**Use MIDI**). Dimmed controls are not modelled; **Show ▾ → Only working controls** hides them.

## Step by step

Each step loads a starting patch made on this page (not one of Vital's presets) and plays it. Listen for the one thing it names, then turn the knob it names.

```{=html}
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="vital-pad" data-set="{&quot;poly&quot;:8}" data-page="voice"><p><b>Eight voices.</b> The pad with <b>VOICES</b> 8: a five-note chord. Listen to all the notes together.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="vital-pad" data-set="{&quot;poly&quot;:1}" data-page="voice"><p><b>One voice.</b> The same pad with <b>VOICES</b> 1. Only one note of the chord is left. Mono is wrong for a pad; set VOICES back to 8.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="vital-bass" data-page="voice"><p><b>A mono bass.</b> <b>VOICES</b> 1, <b>GLIDE</b> -5 (a short slide). Listen to how the notes join, with a tiny slide into each one.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="vital-bass" data-set="{&quot;glide&quot;:-2}" data-page="voice"><p><b>A longer glide.</b> <b>GLIDE</b> -2 (about a quarter of a second). Now you clearly hear the slide between notes, like a fretless bass. Try -1, then -10 (off).</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="vital-lead" data-page="voice"><p><b>Unison.</b> The lead with <b>UNISON</b> 4. Turn it to 8 for a huge stack, then to 1. Notice the panel plays one note at a time while unison is on (this page only).</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="vital-first" data-set="{&quot;glide&quot;:-3,&quot;poly&quot;:8}" data-page="voice"><p><b>Glide on a polyphonic sound.</b> The first sound with <b>GLIDE</b> -3 and 8 voices. Each new note slides from the last one played. Compare with GLIDE -10.</p></div>
```

## In the real Vital

What is different in the plug-in and exactly where to find it. Every line names the file of Vital's source code (github.com/mtytel/vital) it was read from; "(unverified)" means it was not confirmed.

- **VOICE strip** (bottom, under every tab): **VOICES** (polyphony 1-32, starts at 8), VEL TRK and BEND (Vital source, voice_section.cpp; synth_parameters.cpp; synth_constants.h).
- **PORTAMENTO strip:** **GLIDE** (the time; starts at its lowest = off), **SLOPE** (the shape of the slide), and buttons **OCTAVE SCALE**, **ALWAYS GLIDE** and **LEGATO** (Vital source, portamento_section.cpp; synth_parameters.cpp). In most synths *legato* means notes played joined do not restart the envelopes, and *always glide* slides even between separate notes; what Vital's buttons do exactly is not in the notes (unverified).
- **ADVANCED tab, VOICE box:** **NOTE PRIORITY** (which note wins when voices run out: Newest, Oldest, Highest, Lowest, Round Robin; starts on Round Robin) and **VOICE OVERRIDE** (Kill or Steal; starts on Kill) (Vital source, master_controls_interface.cpp; synth_strings.h; synth_parameters.cpp).
- **Unison per oscillator:** each OSC has its own UNISON voices (1-16), detune and detune power (Vital source, oscillator_section.cpp; synth_parameters.cpp).
- **Stacks:** the ADVANCED tab's **STACK** per oscillator: Unison, Center Drop 12, Center Drop 24, Octave, 2x Octave, Power Chord, 2x Power Chord, Major Chord, Minor Chord, Harmonics, Odd Harmonics (Vital source, synth_strings.h; oscillator_advanced_section.cpp). A *Power Chord* stack plays a root and fifth from one key.

## Try it in the real Vital

Open Vital in your DAW (see [Meet Vital](intro-vital.qmd) to install it) and do these in order.

- [ ] Initialize the preset. Play a chord: you hear all its notes (VOICES 8).
- [ ] Set **VOICES** to 1 and play the chord again.
- [ ] With VOICES 1, raise **GLIDE** and play a bass line.
- [ ] Switch **LEGATO** on and play joined notes, then separate notes. Listen for what changes.
- [ ] On OSC 1 set UNISON voices to 5. Open ADVANCED and set OSC 1's **STACK** to *Power Chord*.
- [ ] On ADVANCED, set NOTE PRIORITY to *Highest* with VOICES 1 and hold two keys.

## Check yourself

Click an answer. You will see at once if it is right. Nothing is saved or sent.

```{=html}
<div class="ik-q" data-a="0"><p><b>What is polyphony?</b></p><ul><li>How many notes can play at once</li><li>How loud the synth is</li><li>How fast the LFO is</li><li>The filter's slope</li></ul><p class="ik-why">One voice = one note.</p></div>
<div class="ik-q" data-a="0"><p><b>A bass line often uses…</b></p><ul><li>Voices 1 (mono) with a little glide</li><li>32 voices and long reverb</li><li>No oscillators</li><li>Only the sample</li></ul><p class="ik-why">Step 3.</p></div>
<div class="ik-q" data-a="0"><p><b>What does glide do?</b></p><ul><li>Slides the pitch from one note to the next</li><li>Makes notes louder</li><li>Adds echoes</li><li>Changes the wavetable</li></ul><p class="ik-why">Portamento = glide.</p></div>
<div class="ik-q" data-a="0"><p><b>Where is NOTE PRIORITY in the real Vital?</b></p><ul><li>The ADVANCED tab</li><li>The EFFECTS tab</li><li>Under the filter</li><li>In the preset browser</li></ul><p class="ik-why">master_controls_interface.cpp.</p></div>
<div class="ik-q" data-a="0"><p><b>Which is a real Vital unison stack?</b></p><ul><li>Power Chord</li><li>Ping Pong</li><li>Ladder</li><li>Perlin</li></ul><p class="ik-why">kUnisonStackNames (synth_strings.h).</p></div>
```
